question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **"progress".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Progress"** means moving forward or advancing towards a goal.
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank because it fits with the context of improving or moving forward.
 
• Grammatically, **"progress" **is a noun and can be used in this sentence as an object of the preposition **"toward".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Pitch" **can refer to the highness or lowness of a sound, or the angle or slope of a surface.
 
• **"Complacency" **means a feeling of satisfaction with one's achievements that can lead to a lack of effort or caution.
 
• **"Stamina" **refers to physical or mental endurance or strength.
